description.tr: Vigeland Park, Oslo'nun en büyük parkıdır ve dünyaca ünlü heykeltıraş Gustav Vigeland'ın eserlerini sergileyen bir açık hava müzesidir.
description.en: Vigeland Park is Oslo's largest park and an open-air museum showcasing the works of the world-renowned sculptor Gustav Vigeland.
description.de: Der Vigeland Park ist der größte Park in Oslo und ein Freilichtmuseum, das die Werke des weltberühmten Bildhauers Gustav Vigeland zeigt.

description.tr: Munch Museum, Edvard Munch'un eserlerinin sergilendiği önemli bir sanatsal mekandır. *Çığlık* adlı ünlü tablonun da orijinaline ev sahipliği yapar.
description.en: The Munch Museum is an important artistic venue showcasing the works of Edvard Munch, including the original of his famous painting *The Scream*.
description.de: Das Munch Museum ist ein bedeutender Kunstort, der die Werke von Edvard Munch zeigt, einschließlich des Originals seines berühmten Gemäldes *Der Schrei*.
